body: Docs and comments that drifted against the code (class I5; D5-s1-01, D5-s2-01, D5-s3-51 and the non-policy half of D11-s1-51) and the product page's declared image height (D6-s9-01). Part of #2222. Part of #2298. Each stale statement is corrected or, where a number would go stale again, the number is deleted; four new arms in `tests/doc_claims.py` derive each fact from the production artifact and pin it, each with a null control. Corrections, each checked against the code: - UI labels (D5-s1-01): `strings.json` labels the config-flow menu button `Enter thermal values directly` and `manifest.json` names the integration `Heat Pump Cost Optimizer`. README.md, docs/configuration.md (three places) and docs/setup.md named the button with an "(expert)" suffix, and docs/configuration.md named the picker entry "Heat Pump Optimizer". All five now read what the UI shows. - Console banner (D5-s2-01): the card prints `%c ${CARD_TAG} %c v${CARD_VERSION}` and `tools/release/stamp.py` rewrites `CARD_VERSION` on every release without touching the doc, so a literal version in the sample is stale by the next stamp (it read v6.6.8 when the card was at v7.0.2). The sample now reads `v`, and the sentence after it says what `` is. The existing D5-s1-03 banner null control anchored on the sentence this rewords, so its anchor moved with it and the control now also requires its plant to change the text (it was vacuous on a missing anchor). - Service counts (D5-s3-51): `_async_register_services` registers 13 services on a FakeHass; three statements in `__init__.py` said twelve and one said eleven. The numbers are deleted, not corrected (fixer.md step 9): the sentences do not need them, and `services.py`'s module docstring keeps the one count, now pinned by the new arm. - `tests/structure.py` (D11-s1-51): two comments named `cross_seam_edges` as a live ratcheting row; #1738 folded it into `seam_cut_total`. They now say so. The `cut_views` mention in `cap_problem`'s docstring is left as written: it recounts what the script printed at the time, a record, and `tests/entities.py` requires the three grader copies of `cap_problem` to match `structure.py`'s character for character (see Red checks). - `tests/stress.py` (comment only): "the merge base solves the same fifty-one scenarios" is present tense and the live set has a different size; the number is deleted. This merges after or beside #2368, which also changes `tests/stress.py`: this edit is one comment line in the `__main__` block's baseline-capture comment, and no hunk of #2368 touches or neighbours it. - `docs/index.html` (D6-s9-01, #2298): `img/card/plan-why-light.png` was declared 1056x616 and the file is 1056x792; it now declares 792. The new arm compares every sized `` on every published page against the PNG header. A published page is README.md, the reader docs the file already scans (`DOCS`) and every top-level `docs/*.html`, which GitHub Pages serves; today the sized tags are all on `docs/index.html`, and the arm's anchor is red if that page leaves the list. A first cut read every tracked .md and .html, which put about 1200 records and programme files in `doc_claims.py`'s recorded closure; records are not pages a browser lays out, and fixer.md step 10 leaves them as written. - Closures: the arm opens each PNG it compares (the product page's images were only stat()ed before, so they sat under the INERT `docs/` prefix). The ten it opens are added to `INERT_EXCEPT` in `tests/closure.py`, the route #1413 and R9-WEB-1 took for the docs `doc_claims.py` reads, and `tests/closures.json` is re-derived with `./tests/derive_closures.sh --single tests/doc_claims.py`. A new sized `` adds its PNG there; the closure check refuses it until it does. Alternative considered: a prefix predicate taking all of `docs/img/*.png` off INERT would make the 18 unread PNGs orphans. Alternatives considered for the banner: correcting the literal to the live version would be stale at the next stamp; teaching `stamp.py` to rewrite the doc too adds a second generator target for a sample that needs no specific number. The placeholder removes the cause. For the service counts: correcting twelve to thirteen leaves four sentences a fourteenth service falsifies; the check would catch it, but deleting a number nothing needs is the smaller surface. Not in this group: the D7.md and D9.md lines of #2222 (policy, R10-BRIEFS-FOLD), the `money_currency` comment in coordinator.py (D5-s3-01, R10-CURRENCY), the hot_water_pumps label (R10-UX-SETUP). Per the roster carry, #2222 is fully delivered only when this group merges last of those four; the orchestrator checks. #2298 is fully delivered here. ## Head `57cfd8c47a213b7ce1130687384885e68ac6bca6` merges main `5e0056d` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged. `a85e97a7325fc48767ba5abb1ec4c6fb92506939` merges the authored code head `cc42450a4f9d3dff7feb81ae91a28ccde3bceb32` and then merges origin/main `289426c1f` (an automatic merge by the orchestrator's script; any resolution inside the code head is described below) into this PR's previous head. cc42450a4f9d3dff7feb81ae91a28ccde3bceb32 This head has the same tree as the merge commit `cda643ec4` (`git diff --quiet cda643ec4 cc42450a4` rc 0): an interim commit, 9cf109e42, corrected a `tests/README.md` path and was reverted, because that file is policy and its change needs the owner's approval (Forward-carry). The figures below were taken at 9cf109e42, whose only difference from the head is that one line in `tests/README.md`; the scripts that do not read that file are unaffected, and `tests/entities.py`, which does, is re-run at the head (Figures). ## Mutation proof Failing first: the head's `tests/doc_claims.py` (9cf109e42) copied onto a `git archive` export of merge base df6ca4bc6 and run there as `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/doc_claims.py` printed `5 of 183 checks FAILED`: "every 'Add integration' name and menu-button label in the docs is what the UI shows", "the sample shows the placeholder, not a literal version", "a literal version planted in the sample is refused (null control)" (its plant's anchor is the placeholder line, absent at base), "no comment or docstring states a whole-registry count that differs from it", "every declared width and height equals the PNG header". On an export of the head the same command prints `ALL 183 checks PASSED`. Per production file, on that head export: the file replaced by its merge-base copy, the same command run, the file restored. - `README.md`: 2 of 183 FAILED, "the three setup-flow diagrams are identical" and "every 'Add integration' name and menu-button label in the docs is what the UI shows". - `docs/configuration.md`: 2 of 183 FAILED, the same two. - `docs/setup.md`: 2 of 183 FAILED, the same two. - `docs/dashboard-card.md`: 2 of 183 FAILED, "the sample shows the placeholder, not a literal version" and "a literal version planted in the sample is refused (null control)". - `custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/__init__.py`: 1 of 183 FAILED, "no comment or docstring states a whole-registry count that differs from it". - `docs/index.html`: 1 of 183 FAILED, "every declared width and height equals the PNG header". The `tests/structure.py` and `tests/stress.py` edits are comments no check reads; their evidence is the sweep's W2 and W3 rows below. The `tests/closure.py` entries are pinned by the closure check itself: without them `./tests/derive_closures.sh --single tests/doc_claims.py` refused the recording ("files on the INERT list are actually read by tests", naming the ten PNGs). ## Null control Each new arm plants its defect in memory and requires the reader to fire, and each has an anchor that is red when its subject is absent: - UI labels: a drifted picker name plus a suffixed button label give exactly 2 findings. - Banner: a literal `v6.6.8` planted in the sample gives exactly 1 finding, and the plant must change the text. - Service counts: `"""Registers the twelve services."""` reads as `[(1, 12)]`; a "one of two services" subset reads as `[]`. - Image size: a PNG of 10x20 against declared heights 20 and 30 compares 2 tags and refuses exactly the one at 30. The finder harnesses' own controls, at merge base df6ca4bc6: `sweep_i5.py --null` prints `null_stale=0`; `card_banner.py --perturb` prints `banner_mismatch=0`; `web_claims.py --perturb-dims` prints `img_dim_mismatch=0`. ## Figures Base is a `git archive` export of merge base df6ca4bc6 (the tip of `origin/main` at 2026-10-21T08:40Z), head a `git archive` export of 9cf109e42, each run through `git init -q && git add -A` where `tests/doc_claims.py` needs `git ls-files`; each harness run from that root as `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 ` with the harness taken from the head's tree. - `dev/audit/rounds/round10/D5/s1/ui_labels.py`: `mismatches` 5 at base, 0 at head. - `dev/audit/rounds/round10/D5/leads/service_count_comments.py`: `stale_count_statements` 4 at base, 0 at head. - `dev/audit/rounds/round10/D5/s2/card_banner.py`: `banner_mismatch` 1 at base; at head it raises `AttributeError` on `re.search(...).group`, because its regex reads a numeric version and the sample now carries none, which is the intended end state. Companion, applying the tree's own rule: `tests/doc_claims.py`'s banner arm, red at base and green at head (Mutation proof). - `web_claims.py` from `handoff/audit-r10-d6-web` at 39909e462 (`$EXPORT/dev/audit/rounds/round10/D6/web/web_claims.py`, sha1 5ec0c0a704ad77bb138ddd443ba21dead669b4d5): `img_dim_mismatch` 1 at base, 0 at head. - `node dev/audit/rounds/round10/D11/leads/stale_structure_refs.mjs`: `retired_key_claims` 3 at base, 2 at head; `lint_missed_stale_counts` 1 at both. What remains is D7.md, policy, R10-BRIEFS-FOLD. - Class enumerator `dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/I5/sweep_i5.py` (sha1 7e4115368a0b36069b5a5f51bf77b09bbfeb5a76), STALE lines by arm: base F1 5, F2 1, F3 6, F4 4, W1 1, W2 3, W3 2 (`stale_total=22`); head F3 6, W2 2, W3 1 (`stale_total=9`). Rule: every line the enumerator prints beginning `STALE`, grouped by its second field. Each seam it returns at head, with its disposition: - F3 `coordinator.py` `money_currency`: D5-s3-01, R10-CURRENCY. - F3 `inputs.py` `ATTR_MIN_TEMP`, `ATTR_MAX_TEMP`: not a defect; the comment names Home Assistant's own constants for the `min_temp`/`max_temp` keys the next line uses. - F3 `optimizer.py` `manual_plan_released`: not a defect; it is the event-name suffix `notifier.py` builds as `f"{DOMAIN}_manual_plan_released"`. - F3 `replay_doc.py` `TibberSensorElPrice`: not a defect; the comment names Home Assistant core's Tibber sensor class (a file on main that arrived after this branch was cut, so it is new to the base count). - F3 `plan_step.py` `FORECAST_STEP_MINUTES`: not a defect; the docstring recounts how two modules spelled the step before R10-PUMP-MODEL, a record. - W2 `tests/structure.py` `cut_views` in `cap_problem`'s docstring: a record of a past output, left as written (Corrections). - W2 `dev/governance/dimensions/D7.md` `cross_seam_edges` and W3 `dev/governance/dimensions/D9.md` "51 scenarios": policy, R10-BRIEFS-FOLD. In the git checkout (not the archive) the enumerator also prints three F5 rows at head, all `dev/governance/dimensions/D7.md` lines 13, 17 and 18: policy, R10-BRIEFS-FOLD. - `python3 tests/closure.py select --diff df6ca4bc6` at 9cf109e42: `MODE: FULL`, because the diff edits `tests/closure.py`, a gate file; CI runs every script. At d32bdf502, before that edit, it read `MODE: SCOPED`. - Closure reads of the first cut: at d32bdf502, a `--record-only` recording of the 25 recordable scoped scripts checked with `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/closure.py check --in-dir --partial` printed 1200 lines `tests/doc_claims.py: ` under INERT READS UNDER-APPROXIMATED (722 under `dev/programme/`, 383 under `dev/audit/`); at da78ee636, with the page list, the same check over a `tests/doc_claims.py` recording named 10 paths, the ten PNGs now in `INERT_EXCEPT`. Rule: lines of that output naming `tests/doc_claims.py`. - PNGs under `docs/img/`: `git ls-files 'docs/img/*.png' | wc -l` prints 28; 10 are opened by the arm, so 18 would be orphans under a prefix predicate. - Run locally with `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub`, at 9cf109e42, each line the script's own last summary line and its exit code (every script this body names ran at the head; none is carried from an earlier head): `tests/structure.py` rc=0 STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED; `tests/doc_claims.py` rc=0 ALL 183 checks PASSED; `tests/closure.py selftest` rc=0 ALL 124 closure shrink pins PASSED; `tests/entities.py` rc=0 ALL 2360 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED (re-run at cc42450a4, the head: ALL 2360 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED, rc=0); `tests/deployment_shape.py` rc=0 ALL DEPLOYMENT SHAPE CHECKS PASSED; `tests/validate.py` rc=0 NO ISSUES; `tests/arch_score_head.py` rc=0 ALL 18 ARCHITECTURE SCORE HEAD CHECKS PASSED; `tests/env_drift.py --claims-only origin/main` rc=0 claims hygiene: origin/main ok; `tests/config_flow_steps.py` rc=0 ALL 499 checks PASSED; `tests/harness_headers.py` rc=0 ALL 109 HARNESS HEADER CHECKS PASSED; `tests/layout.py` rc=0 layout self-test: ok; `node tests/md_tables.mjs` rc=0 (`RESULT doc_misrendered_lines=0`). - `tests/stress.py` and every other script are left to CI, which runs the full suite on this diff (`MODE: FULL`); `stress.py` changes by one comment line here. - `python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body BODY.md`: `CARRY-AUDIT: 3 finding item(s): 3 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad destination(s)`, rc=0. ## Red checks - `pr-contract`, at the previous head: `UNROUTED body item edad96f3 (## Forward-carry)`; the item named three destinations in prose and carried no `Carry:` marker. The cheaper detector is `python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py check --body `, which this body now passes (rc 0, below); `tools/pr/prepr.sh` does not call it, so only `pr-contract` ran it before this repair. Standing cost of running it by hand before a push: one local command that reads the roster ref. The recurring class is open as #2428. - `nightly-status`: grades `main`, not this branch. The nightly `slow` lane's `loop_cpu_ratio` is over budget, and the separate `r10-replay-cap` work fixes it. This diff touches no file that lane reads. - Earlier, on this branch and before any push: `tests/entities.py` failed once at 7a4a815e3 (`1 of 2347 ENTITY CHECKS FAILED`, "every grader's copy of the barrier is the original, character for character"), because a reworded `cap_problem` docstring line in `tests/structure.py` is carried verbatim by three graders. The line is a record and was restored as written; the detector that fired is `tests/entities.py`, and nothing new is owed. ## Forward-carry - The D7.md and D9.md lines of #2222 (D11-s1-51: "measures all 24", the `cut_*` and `cross_seam_edges` keys, "record all 51 scenarios") are policy, and R10-BRIEFS-FOLD's brief already lists "the stale D7.md and D9.md lines of #2222 (D11-s1-51)". Carry: R10-BRIEFS-FOLD - The `money_currency` comment in `coordinator.py` (D5-s3-01) is in R10-CURRENCY's brief ("Also take D5-s3-01"). Carry: R10-CURRENCY - `tests/README.md` line 272 cites `tools/audit/harnesses/k1725_blas_kernel_gap.py`, a path that does not exist (the instrument is `dev/audit/harnesses/k1725_blas_kernel_gap.py`); this group's roster carry owes the one-line correction, but the file is policy and a branch that edits it needs the owner's `## Approval`, so it rides a policy group's pull request. Carry: R10-BRIEFS-FOLD - The `hot_water_pumps` label (the roster carry's third item) landed in #2346, R10-UX-SETUP, which is merged: the options-menu label reads "Hot water circulation" in `strings.json`. Carry: dismissed: landed in the merged R10-UX-SETUP pull request #2346 ## Friction none

comments.body: Fix review: merge a85e97a7325fc48767ba5abb1ec4c6fb92506939 Round 1 (no earlier Fix review verdict on #2521). Measured head a85e97a7325fc48767ba5abb1ec4c6fb92506939, re-read as the PR head and branch tip just before writing. Baseline is the merge base 289426c1f; the body's base df6ca4bc6 was also exported for the F3 cross-check. Interpreter: the seat venv /opt/hpo/venv-ci (Python 3.14.7). The container's system Python 3.11 cannot parse tests/entities.py, so under it comment_symbols drops that file's tokens and F3 reads 9 instead of 6, and service_count_comments dies on voluptuous. That is this container's environment, not the PR. Every figure below was taken with the venv. 1 Mutation proof (ev/mutation_proof.txt). At the head, each production file was replaced by its merge-base copy, doc_claims was run, and the file was restored. README.md, docs/configuration.md and docs/setup.md each fail 2 of 183 (the UI-label check, plus the existing check that the setup-flow diagrams are identical). docs/dashboard-card.md fails 2 (the placeholder check and its null control). __init__.py fails 1 (the registry count). docs/index.html fails 1 (the PNG header). All of this matches the body. Failing first: the head's tests/doc_claims.py on the base tree gives 5 of 183 FAILED; the head gives ALL 183 checks PASSED (ev/null_controls_and_failing_first.txt). RESULT mutation_files_reverted=6 all_fail=6 2 Finder harnesses at both ends (ev/finder_harness_both_ends.txt). These are the committed main copies, and web_claims.py comes from handoff/audit-r10-d6-web 39909e462 (sha1 5ec0c0a7, the same as the body). RESULT ui_labels.mismatches base=5 head=0 RESULT service_count_comments.stale_count_statements base=4 head=0 (registered_actions=13 at both) RESULT web_claims.img_dim_mismatch base=1 head=0 (claims false 1 -> 0) RESULT card_banner.banner_mismatch base=1 head=AttributeError -- the body discloses this: the regex expects a numeric version and the sample now has none. I checked the companion myself: the doc_claims banner arm is red at base and green at head. RESULT stale_structure_refs retired_key_claims base=3 head=2, lint_missed_stale_counts 1 at both (the remainder is D7.md, which is policy) 3 Null controls at base: sweep_i5 --null null_stale=0; card_banner --perturb banner_mismatch=0; web_claims --perturb-dims img_dim_mismatch=0; sweep_i5 --perturb stale_W3 2->3. The PR's four in-memory controls pass at the head inside the 183. 4 Claims: no golden or claim file is touched (ev/merge_tree_and_untouched.txt), and env_drift --claims-only origin/main reports ok. 5 VERSION, the manifest and RELEASE_NOTES are untouched. The diff is empty, and pr-contract prints "no version edit". 6 Class: I ran the body's rule (STALE lines of sweep_i5.py, sha1 7e411536) in a checkout. Base: stale_total=26 (F1 5, F2 1, F3 6, F4 4, F5 4, W1 1, W2 3, W3 2). Head: 12 (F3 6, F5 3, W2 2, W3 1). That is the body's archive figures (22 -> 9) plus the F5 rows the body says only a checkout prints. Every seam left at the head is dispositioned in the body. The W4 SEAM rows (dashboard-card.md '24 months', '30 samples') are not STALE lines, so the rule does not count them. Attacks at the head (ev/class_attack_plants.txt): - changing services.py to say 'fourteen services' fires the count check; - a bold '(advanced)' suffix fires the label check; - 'Add integration -> Heat Pump Optimizer' in README fires it; - a wrong height on advisor-light.png fires the PNG check; - a literal v7.0.2 in the banner fires the banner check. The brief asked for image sizes to be checked on every tracked page. The arm narrows that to published pages, and that loses nothing today: all 1365 tracked .md/.html files hold 10 sized tags, and the published pages hold the same 10. Mismatches are 0 in both (ev/class_attack_images.txt). 7 The body names a85e97a73 as the head and describes it as an automatic main merge over the code head cc42450a4. 8 Figures re-derived: mutation counts, 183 checks, finder metrics, 28 tracked docs/img PNGs, 10 opened, and the sweep counts (see 6). The difference comes from the main merge. 9 Every harness the body names is committed, and I built none of my own beyond the readers in ev/ (imgscan.py and pngset.py). title: docs: correct statements that drifted from the code (R10-I5-DOCS)
